verification_log.method: Identifications: Gubaru/Ugbaru; Cyrus (Wiseman 1965, Frye 1994, Colless 1992); Cambyses II; son of Astyages (Josephus, Jerome); Cyaxares II (Jerome, Calvin, Ussher, Keil, Hengstenberg; Hirsch defends Xenophon); Darius I projected (Newsom & Breed 2014); literary figure (Rowley 1935; Hill 2009); "most scholars view this Darius as a literary fiction"
